title: long title truncation
brief: UX directions for long album/track titles in the panel rows (issues #153/#140 arc leftovers): today every theme truncates the row TAIL, losing the count/duration tail such as '9 tracks' or the 43/52 ladder widths. These artboards show two truncate policies that keep the tail visible, versus today's behavior, using real overflow data from the owner's session probes.

artboards.title: Tail keep
artboards.tradeoff: Truncates the TITLE so the count tail always renders; the count survives at every width — the info the owner reads replaces the middle of long names

artboards.title: Middle ellipsis
artboards.tradeoff: Both ends survive: head of the title, then an ellipsis, then the count tail — classic path-style truncation; the mid part of the name is what gets lost, reads easily as long-name compression
